title: IPOS4/5 Two-Layer Ernst Prepared Geometry and Response Structural Candidate

architecture.immutable_preparation: precompute effective base, depth below drain, horizontal and radial resistance terms once per shared parameter set
architecture.dynamic_response: compute only groundwater-dependent vertical resistance, total resistance, exchange and stable-branch derivative
architecture.IPOS4_branch: vertical-resistance derivative changes at groundwater_level=interface_level; derivative unavailable exactly there when branch-sensitive
architecture.IPOS5_branch: vertical resistance is linear in groundwater level with derivative 1/Kv_top
architecture.radial_resistance_policy: may be negative when logarithm argument is between zero and one; validity is based on finite legal operations and positive finite total resistance at evaluation

compatibility_branch.legacy_difference_cutoff: diffl < 1e-10 returns zero exchange before resistance evaluation
compatibility_branch.policy: retain only as explicit restricted B1.10 compatibility semantics
